comparator.name: Ancient Near Eastern Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: The current broad-route product lists four 5 EC course codes twice and lists two 5 EC Philosophy of Science versions with the same core content. The catalogue narrative places Philosophy of Science in year two. The distinct listed content totals 155 EC. The required Roman North Africa seminar gives History-specific prerequisites and does not explain how the broad-route students qualify. The revised credit allocation and that progression need confirmation.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden’s broad Ancient Near Eastern Studies route examines the history, languages, archaeology and material culture of ancient Egypt, the Near East and the Mediterranean. Museum and heritage study complement work with written and material sources.
